purpose: Withdrawn migrations: preserved byte for byte next to this file. They are NOT in supabase/migrations and must never be executed or recorded in any migration history. sha256_working_copy_bytes was computed on the Windows checkout (CRLF); sha256_lf_normalized (CRLF converted to LF, the form git stores) is the stable identity across checkouts. The list is also the deny list for a future allowlist executor.
